mentions.name: fiveb.ar
mentions.description: AI-first, cookieless web analytics hosted in the EU that gives AI agents access to a site's traffic, client and server errors, and page speed via MCP. Installs with a single script tag, requires no cookie banner, and offers a free trial. It runs on a custom CDN so no data is at rest in the US or with a US company, and it started as a side project monitoring traffic across a network of websites and API/MCP endpoints.
